decisions.reason: Product A closely builds on the firm’s existing underground mining machinery and service capabilities, giving it strong absorptive capacity to interpret early results and apply improvements, making withdrawal very unlikely.

Construction site dumpers draw on the firm’s established construction equipment and industrial transport knowledge, so the firm can assimilate early results and refine the product, leading to a low withdrawal probability.

Inclined furniture lifts are adjacent to the firm’s lifting and material handling expertise but less central to its industrial core, so while the firm can learn from early results, there is moderate uncertainty about commercial fit, yielding a moderate drop probability.
Inclined building material lifts align with the firm’s construction and lifting know-how, enabling effective learning from early results and product improvement, so withdrawal is relatively unlikely.

Truck-mounted inclined furniture lifts combine the firm’s vehicle and lifting knowledge in a niche application, providing some absorptive capacity but leaving moderate uncertainty about whether early results justify continued investment.
